scope: Corollary 12.1 (Deep discrepancy in both orientations) of the manuscript “The hypercube Ramsey number has linear order” (preprints/The-hypercube-Ramsey-number-has-linear-order-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 171 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7d4b26e897038267), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 106-107. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In the remaining case, on the simulta- neous retained sets with the full cluster exclusions, there are constants 0 < x∗ < .01, 0 < α < .01 for which |dG(σ, π) − 1/2| ≤ b∗ := n−1+.04 at widths αn, nx∗ , in either order.
